effect.name: GM Blobbylise
effect.desc: Melts the layer into organic blobs. A cellular field is built in layer space, each cell gets a jittered centre and a radius taken from the layer underneath it, and a smooth-minimum union then lets neighbouring blobs fuse wherever they touch. Five looks: Blobs gives flat rounded masses with an outline, Metaballs fuses them into liquid, Liquid Voronoi keeps the cell edges and bends the layer through a lens at every boundary, Cells keeps hard quantised tiles, and Wax pushes the dome shading and gloss so the blobs look cast. Size, wobble, merge distance, gloss, edge and a refraction amount are all separate.
